{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsor shield''' was a security feature employed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] to prevent unauthorized access to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Emperor's throne room (Death Star)/Legends|throne room]] and private quarters.
